thread.title: Apple Shareholder Meeting Could Provide Clues To Strategy | Stock News & Stock Market Analysis - IBD

author: Investor'S Business Daily
title: Apple Shareholder Meeting Could Provide Clues To Strategy | Stock News & Stock Market Analysis - IBD
text:
Reprints 
Apple ( AAPL ) investors hope to get assurances at the company's annual shareholder meeting on Tuesday that the company is on the right course, following signs of slowing sales for its flagship iPhone X smartphone. 
Apple is holding the meeting at the Steve Jobs Theater on its new Apple Park campus in Cupertino, Calif. The meeting will start at 9 a.m. local time. 
X "This meeting comes at a crucial time for Apple as the company has seen a myriad of challenges over the last few months including softer-than-expected demand on its flagship iPhone X model, a delayed HomePod (smart speaker) which missed the crucial holiday season, and shares which have been under considerable pressure and causing agita for tech investors thus far in 2018," GBH Insights analyst Daniel Ives said in a report Sunday. 
As Apple transitions from a growth stock to a value stock, investors will want to hear about the company's strategic plans, Ives said. That includes details of what the company intends to do with more than $200 billion in repatriated foreign profits, he said. 
"While the very choppy market waters and Apple's March guidance have been a tough 'one-two punch' for investors to digest, we believe the strong fundamental picture for Apple for the next 12 to 18 months, attractive risk/reward, and a massive capital return to shareholders (which we hope to hear more about this week) will be enough to move shares back into the $180-$200 range by year-end," Ives said. IBD'S TAKE: Apple stock has an IBD Composite Rating of 62 out of a best-possible 99. For more analysis on Apple, visit the IBD Stock Checkup . 
Ives rates Apple stock as highly attractive with a price target of 205. 
Apple shares were up 3.1%, near 161.30, in morning trading on the stock market today . Apple stock hit an all-time high of 180.10 on Jan. 18, before the broad market sell-off. 
Apple is unlikely to discuss upcoming products and services at the meeting. It is widely believed to be prepping three new iPhones for a fall release and a video-on-demand service, among other offerings.
